scientific_integrity: Structural proof and exhaustive small-case verification; no independent human audit or independent priority certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conjugacy is under units and centralizers are in the whole monoid; only n=2,3 are exhaustively tested. The arXiv/publisher full text of the closely related July 2026 Baiduk–Kozerenko source was unavailable for conclusive overlap comparison, so historical equivalence remains possible.
title: Unit-conjugacy profiles and commutant counts for idempotents of the finite magma monoid
